newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to begin futures trading May 23.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to begin futures trading May 23.

text.p: Venezuela will open futures trading on the Caracas stock exchange this May -- a program that is expected to expand quickly to include options, Futures and Options business chamber Cacofv said.
"We'll open with futures trading on May 23," Cacofv president Jose Gonzalo Muci told Reuters.
"We expect to begin with futures contracts on the bolivar/dollar exchange rate, interest rates and stock exchange indices."
A second stage will include bolivar/dollar options and options on interest rate futures, he added.
Cacofv counts the country's largest banks among its shareholders, including Banco Provincial and Banco Mercantil.
